material.head: Broke out of a 7-week base
material.text: On Oct 22 it closed above the top of a 7-week base (10% deep), on 1.0x average volume, lighter than a strong breakout carries. 2 of the 2 closes from the break on held above the level it broke, and the break session closed 2 ATR past it on a 2.3-ATR range: a stretched spike.

material.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
material.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Sep 22): the run of lower highs is broken.

material.head: Support −2.7% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −2.7% below (1 ATR), where 10 levels of 5 kinds meet: the Jun 22 low, the average price paid since the Aug 25 high and the 50-day average.

fear.label: Fear day: Fri Oct 23
fear.text: Fri Oct 23: SPY and MZTI both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.
